description: Bayer 2x4 unpack plus a directional green-pair decision for two non-green centres. Packing: a = line-buffer row0 in (G R G R) phase, a[7:0]=t0 green, a[15:8]=t1 red = lane0 centre, a[23:16]=t2 green, a[31:24]=t3 red (tapped by the following beat, unused here); b = row1 in (B G B G) phase, b[7:0]=u0 blue, b[15:8]=u1 green, b[23:16]=u2 blue = lane1 centre, b[31:24]=u3 green; c[7:0]=the row-above green under t1, c[15:8]=the row-below green under u2, c[31:16] must be zero. Lane0 green taps: left t0, right t2, above c[7:0], below u1. Lane1 green taps: left u1, right u3, above t2, below c[15:8]. With centre C and greens Gu,Gd,Gl,Gr the directional scores are Sv=2*|Gu-Gd|+|Gu+Gd-2C| and Sh=2*|Gl-Gr|+|Gl+Gr-2C| (2C as C<<1, magnitudes by compare-then-subtract). Vertical wins iff Sv<Sh, horizontal iff Sh<Sv, otherwise the isotropic four-green mean is used. result[7:0]=lane0 green estimate, result[15:8]=lane1 green estimate, result[23:16]=lane0 centre sample and result[31:24]=lane1 centre sample (the chroma carried out with it). Estimate = (Gu+Gd+1)>>1 vertical, (Gl+Gr+1)>>1 horizontal, (Gu+Gd+Gl+Gr+2)>>2 on a tie. aux[0]=lane0 vertical won, aux[1]=lane0 horizontal won, aux[3:2]=the same two-bit code for lane1, so a tie sets both bits of its lane; aux[31:4] always zero. fault=nonzero c[31:16], with result=aux=0.
hardware_advantage: Green-plane demosaicing costs a scalar core two absolute-difference pairs, a centre-consistency term and a three-way branch per pixel; two Bayer sites are graded, selected and averaged in one beat and the winning direction is reported next to the pixel.
